question: The rate of oil is increased by 12% every year. The rate in the next year would be ₹125.44 per litre. What is the difference between the prices (in ₹) per litre of the oil in the last year and this year?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of oil this year = ₹125.44 per litre.

Rate of oil increases by 12% every year.

**Formula Used:**

Rate of oil last year = Rate of oil this year / (1 + Increase Rate).

Difference in rates = Rate of oil this year - Rate of oil last year.

**Calculation:**

Rate of oil this year = ₹125.44 / (1 + 12/100)

⇒ ₹125.44 / 1.12

⇒ ₹112.00

Rate of oil last year = ₹112 / (1 + 12/100)

⇒ ₹112 / 1.12

⇒ ₹100

Difference in rates = ₹112 - ₹100

⇒ ₹12

**The difference between the prices per litre of the oil in the last year and this year is ₹12.**
